meta.title: Kostanda Beauty · Aesthetic medicine clinic in central Valencia

scan.title: Your mirror can't see what the scanner sees
scan.lead: Redness, pigment that hasn't reached the surface yet, bacteria in the pores, dilated vessels. The Observ 520x photographs the skin under different lights and shows the layers you can't see with the naked eye. That's how we decide what to do and, above all, what not to do.

rules.title: My rules
rules.lead: I wrote them for my patients and keep them at every consultation.

items.d: I often say: "Your face, your decision." My job is to recommend honestly and professionally. The decision is always yours.

items.t: I don't compete on low prices
items.d: Because I value my experience, my team and quality. People don't go to a cosmetologist for a discount, but for results and trust.

items.t: I don't poach other specialists' patients
items.d: That's not my philosophy. Everyone chooses their doctor by feel, by their view of beauty and by human qualities.

items.t: I don't comment on other doctors' advice
items.d: In my consulting room I only talk about you and my work. Other people's decisions are not my territory.
I don't save on knowledge or haggle over it. I invest in quality, safety and new possibilities for my patients.

items.t: Technology isn't for looking good on Instagram
items.d: It's for safety, effectiveness and the best solutions for patients.
I don't try to please you. It's fine if you don't like what I say: a cosmetologist doesn't just "do a treatment", she guides you towards sensible, realistic care.

rules.closing: Sometimes choosing a husband is easier than choosing your cosmetologist. Want to find out if we see things the same way? Come for a consultation.

story.title: Becoming a doctor again
story.lead: I came to Spain as an endocrinologist who spoke no Spanish. To practise again, I had to start almost from zero.

steps.d: I dreamed of working at the regional hospital in Kharkiv, and I did. But what always drew me was the skin.
Yesterday you were a doctor; today, in a new country, formally you're not. A tutor four times a week, almost without breaks.
It's not an exam where memorising answers is enough: you have to understand, write and speak fluently. After months of preparation: "APTO".
Diplomas, translations, apostilles, months of waiting. Those numbers meant far more than a registration: I can work as a doctor again.

steps.t: A doctor in Spain, with her own clinic
steps.d: Kostanda Beauty opened in November 2024 at Guillem de Castro 8. I keep training at international congresses such as IMCAS in Paris.

story.quote: Today I'm a doctor again. And I haven't stopped: I keep studying, and that's what I bring to every appointment.

team.title: Your face, in a doctor's hands
team.lead: A team that explains every step before starting, works to medical protocols and trains together: in Madrid, in Paris, and on every new device before using it with patients.

members.d: Diagnosis, injectables, device treatments and treatment plans.
Over 10 years of experience. Master's degrees in Aesthetics from Complutense University of Madrid and CEU Valencia, and a Master's in Nutrition.

items.q: I don't know what my skin needs. Where do I start?
items.a: With a diagnosis. We analyse your skin, explain what we see and suggest a plan of treatments and home care. If you need nothing, we'll say so.
It depends on what the diagnosis shows, which is why we don't publish a price list. Before any treatment you get the exact price. The online consultation is free.

items.q: Can I have a consultation if I'm not in Valencia?
items.a: Yes. Online, we review your current routine and recommend products. Afterwards you get 5% off professional skincare for 7 days.

items.q: I have fillers from another clinic. Can you assess them?
items.a: Yes. A facial ultrasound shows whether product remains, where and how deep. If it needs correcting, hyaluronidase is applied in a targeted way under ultrasound guidance, not blindly.
Before we start we explain what you'll feel and choose the most comfortable technique. As one patient put it: «Всё прошло совершенно безболезненно» (it was completely painless).
Yes. More and more men come to look after their skin: RF microneedling, facials, device treatments, trichology and massage.
